timeline.message:
Fix testNoRebalanceOnRollingRestart

This test would sometimes fail to keep the shards on their original
nodes because the ignored `ShardRouting` objects had a different
`allocationStatus` from the ones in the routing table. With this commit
we fix the status at `NO_ATTEMPT` to avoid the problem.

Closes #91441
timeline.author: David Turner

timeline.body:
This test would sometimes fail to keep the shards on their original nodes because the ignored `ShardRouting` objects had a different `allocationStatus` from the ones in the routing table. With this commit we fix the status at `NO_ATTEMPT` to avoid the problem.

Closes #91441

timeline.body:
I believe `recoveryState.getPrimary() == false` could be removed since all shards in this test are primaries.
It would be also great to report all shard movements, not just the first one in case of failure
